candidate_generation.exclude: each user's Train-seen movies before Top-500
candidate_generation.unknown_genre_policy: selection diversity contribution=0; metric pair diversity=0; coverage reported separately

protocol.cohort: same global-time-v1 warm latest held-out item with Train-only shrunk ECDF >= 0.7

policies.CONTENT_GENRE: Train centered-rating normalized genre profile cosine; full-universe midrank percentile
policies.EXPLORE_05_ON_POPULARITY: Popularity Top-500 then greedy 0.95 popularity + 0.05*(0.5 novelty percentile + 0.5 marginal genre diversity)
policies.HYBRID_CONTENT_25: 0.75 popularity full-universe midrank percentile + 0.25 content full-universe midrank percentile
